title: Customer Success Manager - Agriculture
description:
🌎 WHAT WE DO

ROOT IS EUROPE’S #1 PRIMARY DATA COLLECTION PLATFORM FOR F&B COMPANIES. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS TO MEASURE AND REDUCE FARM-LEVEL EMISSIONS.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.

We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

🔭 WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

Your mission

Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy.

📅 Over the next months, you will…

Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers

- Own the success of a defined customer portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform

- Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end, driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery

- Design and run farmer-facing enablement, including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level

- Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy

- Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations.

🧺 What you bring along

- Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives)

- Hands-on and detail-oriented, you thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, can juggle multiple tasks, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

- First experience in Customer Success, Operations or other fast-paced environments, where you supported or executed customer-facing processes end-to-end

- People-centric and proactive, empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities in mind

- Comfortable working with data in Excel and digital platforms, with an eye for completeness and consistency

- Fluent in German and English; additional languages (Polish, French, Portuguese, Spanish) are a plus

- Work from our Berlin office 5 days a week

🤗 You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. The only thing you need to ensure along the recruiting process and beyond is that the problem that we are solving with Root is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning!

title: Inbound Appointment Setter
description:
Why WarriorBabe ?

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.
Our Mission
Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.
About the Role
At WarriorBabe , we hire only the best of the best.
As an Inbound Appointment Setter, reporting to WarriorBabe 's Sales Leadership, you play a pivotal role in driving the success of our high-ticket VIP Program. This is a fast-paced, high-volume, performance-driven sales opportunity that demands strong communication, exceptional work ethic, sales acumen, deep belief in the WarriorBabe methodology, and an unwavering passion for helping women transform their health and lives.
Your primary responsibility is to connect with women who have purchased a low-ticket WarriorBabe product, conduct an initial Implementation Call, understand their goals and needs, determine whether they may be a qualified fit for additional support, and ascend qualified prospects into a one-on-one enrollment call with an Enrollment Advisor.
This role serves as a critical bridge between a prospective client's initial experience with WarriorBabe and the opportunity to receive deeper, personalized support through our high-ticket VIP Program.
What You'll Do
Drive Qualified Appointments
Conduct high-volume Implementation Calls and consistently identify, qualify, and book appropriate prospects for one-on-one enrollment calls with an Enrollment Advisor.
You'll conduct scheduled 15-to-30-minute Implementation Calls over Zoom, often in back-to-back blocks throughout the workday, and manage a high daily volume of scheduled calls, typically upwards of 12 or more calls per day.
Deliver an Exceptional Client Experience
Provide a world-class first point of human connection with WarriorBabe , ensuring every woman feels seen, heard, supported, and confident in her next step.
You'll lead focused conversations to understand each prospect's goals, challenges, history, needs, and desired outcomes while identifying opportunities for deeper support.
Qualify and Set Appointments
Effectively vet and qualify prospective clients based on established WarriorBabe criteria.
You'll identify qualified opportunities and confidently ascend appropriate prospects into a one-on-one enrollment call with an Enrollment Advisor, clearly communicate the purpose and value of the conversation, and set accurate expectations for the next step in the sales process.
You'll ensure qualified appointments are booked accurately and with appropriate urgency while maintaining a high standard of appointment quality at significant call volume.
Own Your Pipeline
Take full ownership of assigned prospects and follow-up opportunities.
You'll complete timely and consistent follow-up through assigned communication channels, maintain accurate and up-to-date records within HubSpot, and keep pipeline stages, notes, tasks, follow-up dates, and prospect information current and organized.
We expect our Inbound Appointment Setters to proactively manage opportunities without requiring ongoing reminders or oversight from leadership and ensure qualified opportunities do not fall through the cracks.
Maintain Accurate Reporting
Complete all required End-of-Day and End-of-Week reporting accurately and on time, maintain all assigned manual sales trackers, and ensure CRM documentation and pipeline data remain accurate and current.

title: Medical Assistant

In this role, you’ll work closely with providers and clinical teams to room patients, obtain vitals, assist with procedures, document within the EMR, and help ensure an exceptional patient experience throughout each visit.

We are proud to offer more than just a job-we offer a career environment where high performers are recognized, supported, and rewarded through competitive compensation, quarterly bonus opportunities, and clear pathways for growth within the organization.

• Rooming patients and obtaining vital signs

• Supporting physicians during in-office procedures and treatments

• Preparing exam and procedure rooms for daily clinic flow

• Assisting with patient intake, triage, and EMR documentation

• Educating patients before and after procedures

• Collaborating with front desk and clinical teams to ensure a seamless patient experience

• Maintaining clinic organization, cleanliness, and inventory throughout the day

What You’ll Do

• Room patients and obtain accurate vital signs

• Prepare patients for exams and procedures

• Assist providers during in-office procedures and treatments

• Document patient information accurately within the EMR system

• Obtain patient histories and communicate findings to providers

• Deliver compassionate, patient-centered care during every interaction

What You’ll Bring

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a patient-first mindset

• Ability to manage patient concerns with professionalism, empathy, and urgency

title: AI Researcher
description:
About FirstPrinciples : FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries.
We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3).
Job Description:We are looking for a Member of Technical Staff, Research to investigate, design, test and develop state of the art (SOTA) methods and applications, which can be integrated into the broader AI engine FirstPrinciples is developing. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and your work will flow straight into production, helping advance the way scientific research is performed. Your work will impact the wider academic community through the development of unique solutions to usher in a new era of scientific discovery. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in AI research, who can combine strategic thinking with technical depth to bring complex ideas to life.
Key Responsibilities:
Fundamental Model Research:

• Research, design, and test novel, research‑specific model architectures that integrate academic literature, natural language processing (NLP), symbolic reasoning, and other methods to orchestrate the scientific process.

• Prototype and build custom tokenizers for LaTeX symbols and physical units to be treated as tokens.

• Explore alternatives to transformers through in-depth research and provide practical recommendations for model development.

• Develop reinforcement-learning loops to enable models to run independent and internal thought experiments.

Multimodal Data & Benchmarking:

• Design and automate data ingestion pipelines in collaboration with our Data Scientists & Engineers that aggregates science literature, metadata, experimental data, equations and other data sources in a robust and scalable manner.

• Establish custom benchmarks to assess the models’ understanding of physical concepts, mathematical reasoning abilities, and ability to minimize hallucinations for the benefit of scientific reliability.

• Refine and release datasets and baselines once internal tests are stable.

Training, Testing & Safety:

• Run and track model training jobs while leading the technical team through set-up, monitoring progress, and constraining costs within budget.

• Develop approaches to stage “practice runs” in a sandbox environment to develop the model’s abilities to explore ideas independently while logging results for later review.

• Develop a framework to evaluate the models’ learning using visual and statistical tools to spot patterns and blind spots.

• Add guard-rails and tests that flag poor quality model output.

• Maintain internal tools to track lists of known issues, noting failures, clear fixes, and improvements to be integrated into future development

Collaboration & Technical Guidance:

• Work with the engineering team to ensure product feasibility and robust architecture.

• Translate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders in clear terms.

• Present findings in clear updates to the technical team in order to keep the broader team appraised of progress against research milestones.

Qualifications:

• Educational Background : PhD in physics, computer science, data science, information systems, or related field.

• Experience : Proven track record of conducting in-depth research on scientific AI models, symbolic models, machine learning or deep learning for scientific discovery.

title: Senior 3d Artist
Have a civic idea? (earlier stage)
description:
The Context
Our work is grounded in the idea that some of our hardest challenges - posed by increasing inequality and climate change - are some of our biggest collective opportunities to innovate.
As a civic incubator, Edge partners with public, private, and nonprofit organizations to tackle systemic economic challenges in Stockton. With a focus on three key areas - jobs and workforce, climate, and community wealth - Edge seeds and supports partner-led initiatives with a range of tools. These tools include access to capital, talent, policy support, and coalition-building.
As we identify those 'edge' challenges, we partner with organizations to design creative, non-traditional solutions to them - and incubate them (anywhere from several months to several years ), until the point at which they're ready to be 'spun out' to live on their own. By virtue of the way that we work, we are always interested in learning how others think about these things.
The Engagement
Don't see a role that's a good fit for you, but intrigued by our work as a civic incubator? We'd love to hear from you. While we have a small and mighty team that is focused on incubating existing initiatives (in Stockton, CA), we're open to meeting individuals across the US who are in pursuit of tackling civic challenges. For individuals who want to share their emerging interests and learn from the way that Edge Collaborative does civic incubation, please apply with a proposal.
If you have a pressing civic challenge or idea to share, we'd love to hear from you. Please feel free to outline the answers to these questions in your proposal, in addition to whatever else you'd like to share with the Edge Collaborative team.
Part A
1. What civic challenges do you believe are being ignored? Why are these critical to address now?
2. What idea (earlier stage) or concept (later stage) would you like to work on? What compelled you to think that it needs to be further explored and better understood? What initially inspired you?
3. Are you proposing to affiliate with Edge Collaborative for a shorter or longer period of time? Do you have a sense of what type of support you might require from the Edge team? Examples: intellectual sounding board, access to community relationships, technical assistance, fundraising support, etc. Are you interested in a volunteer position, or a paid one?
Team Values
Beginner’s mindset - we love asking the ‘stupid questions’ to understand what is possible. Our greatest asset is our curiosity as beginners (not experts). We want to discover how and why particular systems and people have been historically neglected by the public and private sectors.
Undaunted - we believe that bold solutions emerge from the margins (or edges, as we might say). The first answer is usually never right, but we’re not afraid of being wrong. We bring a passionate persistence to breaking through the stalemates and road blocks.
Boundless creativity - we thrive as a team. We take inspiration from “keystone species” in ecology - modeling our work after the resourcefulness of penguins and the vibrancy of bees. We cross-pollinate ideas, sectors, and institutions to help manifest the untapped potential of the people we serve.
Humility in service of community - we care deeply about the communities in which we work, and endeavor to put their needs at the center of how we design and incubate new initiatives. We strive to balance the boldness of our imagination with the recognition that slow, sustained trust building with partners is critical to the long-term viability of the work.
Sheer whimsy - we believe that serious work calls for a playful attitude, as we imagine what is possible. Play is derived from a place of joy and speaks to how we aspire to brighten our days. Plus, what’s life without a lil bit of whimsy?

• Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

• Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

• Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

• Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

• Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

• Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

• Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

• Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

• Can set direction and still go deep into details.

• Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

• Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

• Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

• Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

This Role Is Not For

• Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

• People who cannot go deep into product details.

• Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

• Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

• People who need large teams before they can create progress.

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain .
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.
We view our company as an urban neighborhood-a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. About Consulting at F&T Labs
If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.
First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.
We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us - it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.
Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.
One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds - they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.
At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

title: Senior ML Ops Engineer
description:
Are you a collaborative Machine Learning Ops Engineer looking to work for a mission driven global organization?
Are you looking to drive cutting edge products that have a true societal impact?
About the team, this team that powers Elsevier’s Health platforms: Clinical Key AI, Sherpath AI, and AI-driven automated clinical and content workflows. You will bridge Data Science and Engineering to turn experimental NLP/IR/GenAI models into secure, reliable, and scalable services. Our systems operate over one of the world’s largest medical and scholarly landscapes.
About the role, as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer you’ll work on AI-based features (GenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, etc.) search/ranking quality, and knowledge graph aware retrieval while enforcing content rights and editorial confidentiality.
Key Responsibilities
ML & LLM Engineering, Search and Recommendation Engines

• Automate and orchestrate machine learning workflows across major cloud and AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Databricks, and foundation model APIs such as OpenAI).

• Maintain and version model registries and artifact stores to ensure reproducibility and governance.

• Develop and manage CI/CD for ML, including automated data validation, model testing, and deployment.

• Implement ML Engineering solutions using popular MLOps platforms such as AWS SageMaker, MLflow, Azure ML.

• Scale end-end custom Sagemaker pipelines.

• Design and implement the engineering components of GAR+RAG systems (e.g., query interpretation and reflection, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, semantic search), manage prompt libraries, guardrails and structured output for LLMs hosted on Bedrock/SageMaker or self-hosted.

• Design and implement ML pipelines that utilize Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/Solr, vector DBs, and graph DBs .

• Build evaluation pipelines: offline IR metrics (NDCG, MAP, MRR), LLM quality metrics (faithfulness, grounding), and A/B testing.

• Optimize infrastructure costs through monitoring, scaling strategies, and efficient resource utilization.

• Stay current with the latest GAI research, NLP and RAG and apply the state-of-the-art in our experiments and systems.

Collaboration

• Partner with Subject-Matter Experts, Product Managers, Data Scientists and Responsible AI experts to translate business problems into cutting edge data science solutions

• Collaborate and interface with Operations Engineers who deploy and run production infrastructure.

Qualifications

• Current experience in ML Engineering, MLOps platforms, shipping ML or search/GenAI systems to production.

• Strong Python, Java, and/or Scala experience will be considered a plus.

• Hands-on‑ experience with major cloud vendor solutions (AWS, Azure and/or Google)

• Experience with Search/vector/graph technologies (e.g., Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Solr / Neo4j).

• Experience in evaluating LLM models.

• A strong understanding of the Data Science Life Cycle including feature engineering, model training, and evaluation metrics.

• Background in health technology and/or medical content workflows is preferred.

• Familiarity with ML frameworks, e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, PySpark.

• Experience with large-scale data processing systems, e.g., Spark.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Board of Innovation

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.
About the Role
We're looking for an AI Engineer to design and build the AI systems behind real, production-grade applications. This is applied engineering work: building agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and orchestration layers that integrate into business-critical environments and stand up to real-world use.
You'll take AI capabilities from idea to deployment, owning the full path including evaluation, observability, and the operational concerns that determine whether a system survives contact with users.
What You'll Do
You'll design, implement, and ship AI systems that automate work, support decisions, and unlock new workflows for enterprise clients. Day-to-day, that means building multi-step agents and tool-using LLM systems, wiring them into structured and unstructured data sources, and packaging them into services that other engineers and applications can consume safely.
You'll also own how we know our systems work. That includes evals, observability, and the feedback loops that let us iterate with confidence rather than guesswork. You'll work closely with engineers, strategists, and designers, and you'll be in client conversations from early scoping through delivery.
What You Bring
You have 3+ years of experience shipping AI-powered systems in production, and a background in computer science, math, physics, engineering, or another technical or scientific field. You're strong in Python and fluent in the patterns of modern LLM engineering: agents, MCP, skills, tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, and evals.
You're also a real software engineer underneath. CI/CD, testing, version control hygiene, and code quality matter to you, because they're what let you keep moving fast without things falling over. You understand how to balance accuracy, latency, cost, and maintainability, and you've debugged enough production systems to have opinions about it. You're comfortable wrapping AI logic into services that other engineers can consume without surprises.
How You Work
You treat AI as an engineering discipline. You care about observability, maintainability, and the underlying engineering that makes the interesting parts possible. You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain and a new set of constraints.
At BOI, you will work a lot with strategists, designers, and consultants, and most of your clients aren't technical. You're comfortable translating between business problems and technical solutions, and you can hold your own in a client room without a project manager running interference for you.
The field moves quickly, and so do we. New models, new tools, and new patterns show up constantly. You enjoy that pace, actively pull in what's useful, and bring it back to the team. You push back when something doesn't make sense, and you care about building systems that get used long after the kickoff energy fades.
Contract & Setup
We are open to both permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements. The final setup will depend on your location, work authorization status, and local compliance requirements.
Interested?
If this sounds like a fit, apply with your CV and a short note on a system you've built that you're proud of. Bonus points for something we can actually look at!

Damedic übernimmt den kompletten Prozess der Fallabrechnung: Unsere internen Experten in der medizinischen Kodierung arbeiten Hand in Hand mit unserer KI-basierten Kodierplattform. So gestalten wir die Kodierprozesse von morgen - effizient, zuverlässig und mit menschlichem Fachwissen im Zentrum.
darum brauchen wir dich
KI-native Prozesse verändern grundlegend, was Infrastruktur bedeutet. Was gestern vor allem Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes und CI/CD was, ist heute die Frage: Wie schaffen wir eine Entwicklungsumgebung, in der KI-Agenten, Automatisierung, internes Wissen und Engineering-Prozesse sicher, sinnvoll und skalierbar zusammenspielen?

Für diese Transformation gibt es keinen Blueprint - Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung und gestaltest diesen Weg aktiv mit - durch kluge Prozesse, nachhaltige Standards, moderne Tools und enge persönliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams.

Das erwartet dich

Team-Play & Moderne Developer Experience

•
Führung auf Augenhöhe: Du übernimmst die disziplinarische und fachliche Leitung unseres zweiköpfigen DevEx-Teams. Du verstehst dich als Teamplayer und Enabler, der gemeinsam mit dem Team die Produktivität im gesamten Engineering vorantreibt.

•
DevEx im KI-Zeitalter: Für dich ist DevEx weit mehr als nur lokales Setup und Deployments. Du gestaltest die Rahmenbedingungen für modernes Arbeiten: von Context-Engineering für KI-Agenten über Standards für Skills bis hin zu Entwicklungsprozessen für das Knowledge-Management und die damit verbundenen Tools.

•
Prozesse als Enabler: Du überführst Best Practices in gemeinsame Standards.. Du schaffst Ease of Mind für Entwickler und machst die Organisation als Ganzes effektiver.

•
Messbarer Erfolg: Den Erfolg deiner Arbeit misst du an der Entwicklung des Unternehmens und direktem Feedback, aber eben auch an Key-KPIs wie unserem internen DevEx-Index und DORA-Metriken.

Plattform-Betrieb, Evolution & Automatisierung

•
Betrieb & Cloud: Verantwortung für den stabilen Betrieb unserer AWS/EKS-Landschaft sowie unseres on-premise Systems..

•
Incident- & Alert-Management: Du optimierst den First-Responder-Prozess - u.a. durch Optimierung unseres DevOps-Assistenten.

•
Evolution der Plattform: Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Infrastruktur zur Stärkung der IT-Security, Etablierung von Best Practices und Optimierung der Cost Efficiency.

•
Compliance & Resilience: Sicherstellung aller Abläufe im Einklang mit unseren Compliance-Zertifizierungen (ISO 27001, BSI C5).

das bieten wir

•
Infrastruktur als Wachstumshebel: Bei Damedic ist Infrastruktur kein reiner Betrieb, sondern ein zentraler Produktivitätshebel für Engineering und Produktentwicklung.

•
Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst aktiv, was Developer Experience, Infrastruktur und KI-native Arbeitsweisen bei Damedic künftig bedeuten..

•
Direkte Wirkung: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst unmittelbar, wie schnell, sicher und produktiv unsere Engineering-Teams arbeiten.

•
Healthcare mit Sinn: Unsere Technologie hilft Krankenhäusern, administrativen Aufwand zu reduzieren und mehr Fokus auf Patientenversorgung zu ermöglichen.

•
Remote mit persönlicher Note: Wir arbeiten remote-first innerhalb Deutschlands, übernehmen Kosten für Homeoffice-Ausstattung oder einen Co-Working-Platz, kommen regelmäßig persönlich zusammen und legen auch noch ein Deutschlandticket oben drauf.

Später rollst du ein automatisiertes Dev-Setup breiter aus, sammelst Feedback von Engineers und machst aus einem guten Tool einen genutzten Standard.

title: Senior Swift Engineer (Full-Time)
description:

• You’re based in Europe. Remote is fine, but we value real overlap for pairing and quick conversations

The team
Four founders in Amsterdam with decades of experience building great products. We built a healthy, profitable business by making something useful. That’s it. No pitch decks, no runway anxiety, no permission needed.
We shape and build together, using Pairio every day to make Pairio better.

tags: Experience by Industrious (Roles employed by CBRE)
description:
ABOUT EXPERIENCE BY INDUSTRIOUS

CBRE is the world's largest commercial real estate services firm. Experience by Industrious is CBRE's global experience and hospitality business. We partner with leading companies and landlords to design and operate workplaces people love coming to. We treat the daily experience of work as a product worth obsessing over, and we build our teams with people who feel the same way.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The first thing someone experiences when they arrive at a building sets the tone for everything that follows. You're that first thing.

As a Lobby Ambassador, your job is to make arrivals and departures feel smooth, welcoming, and professional. You greet tenants by name, manage the visitor check-in process, answer questions about the building, and make sure the lobby always looks and feels the way it should.

This is a hospitality role grounded in consistency. The value you create isn't in occasional big moments - it's in showing up the same way every single day, so tenants know exactly what to expect when they walk through the door.

This is an in-person position that requires standing for extended periods of time.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Every tenant is greeted by name. Every guest knows exactly where to go. Every arrival feels easy.

• The lobby is always clean, organized, and ready. Facilities and IT issues are escalated before anyone has to ask.

• Your reliability is a given. The team knows you'll be there, you'll be on, and things will be handled.

• Tenants trust you with their preferences and feedback because you've shown them you act on it.

• You're a positive presence in the building. People are glad to see you.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE AND SUCCEED AT IT IF

• Consistency feels like a strength, not a limitation. You take genuine pride in showing up the same way every day. The reliability you offer isn't boring to you - it's something you've built deliberately.

• You enjoy greeting people. Not as a performance, but as a real interaction. You like learning names, asking how things are going, and making someone's start to the day a little better.

• You notice things. When the lobby needs attention, when a guest looks confused, when a package is sitting unclaimed - you see it, and you take care of it.

• You're calm in busy environments. A busy morning, a complicated visitor check-in, an unexpected question - none of it rattles you. You've got a process and you trust it.

• Being on your feet works for you. You're not sitting behind a desk waiting for things to happen. You're present, engaged, and active throughout the day.

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You'd rather work behind the scenes than interact with people face-to-face throughout the day.

• You find daily repetition (greetings, check-ins, basic guest support) draining rather than grounding.

• Standing for long periods or moving between small tasks throughout a shift feels physically difficult.

• You're not comfortable taking ownership of lobby issues and seeing them through to resolution.

• You see hospitality as optional rather than the core of what this role is.

WHAT YOU OWN

Arrivals and front-of-house.

• Greet tenants by name every time they enter or leave the building.

• Manage the visitor system: pre-register guests, check them in, and guide them to their destinations.

• Keep the lobby clean and welcoming; report and escalate any facilities or IT issues.

• Act as the first point of contact for any activities or emergencies in the lobby.

Building knowledge.

• Learn and memorize building FAQs so you can confidently answer questions about the building, amenities, and nearby restaurants or services.

• Join daily standup meetings to prepare for expected events and arrivals.

• Help track tenant preferences as part of the tenant experience team.

Service culture.

• Always embody Industrious and landlord service values in every interaction.

title: Senior Power Controls Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking an experienced Power Controls Engineer to develop and implement advanced control algorithms for high-performance power electronic systems. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in control system modeling and simulation - particularly in Simulink and PLECS - who can take a controls concept from simulation through hardware validation. This individual will own the control architecture for DC/DC converters, inverters, and motor drives built around discrete SiC and GaN power stages, and will work closely with power hardware and firmware engineers to deliver tightly integrated, high-reliability systems for defense and aerospace applications.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Design, simulate, and validate closed-loop control algorithms for switch-mode power converters and inverters using Simulink and/or PLECS.

• Controls for 3-phase AC systems, with and without a switched Neutral

• Develop plant models and controller architectures (voltage-mode, current-mode, sensorless FOC, etc.) for multi-kW power stages utilizing discrete SiC and GaN FETs.

• Perform stability analysis, loop shaping, and compensator design to meet transient response, efficiency, and EMI targets.

• Collaborate with power hardware engineers on gate drive tuning, dead-time optimization, and switching-loss characterization of wide-bandgap devices.

• Support model-based code generation workflows and work with firmware engineers to translate control designs into embedded implementations.

• Define and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and power-hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) test plans to validate control performance against system requirements.

• Contribute to trade studies on converter topology, modulation strategy, and control bandwidth as they relate to size, weight, power, and thermal constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related discipline.

• 8+ years of experience designing and tuning digital control loops for power electronic converters (DC/DC, DC/AC, or motor drives).

• Proficiency in Simulink and/or PLECS for control system modeling, simulation, and analysis.

• Strong foundation in control theory - z-domain and s-domain design, bode analysis, state-space methods, and discrete-time implementation considerations.

• Hands-on experience with discrete SiC and/or GaN FET-based power stages in the multi-kW range.

• Familiarity with military or aerospace environments and standards such as MIL-STD-461, 464, 810, or DO-160.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• MS/PhD with a focus in power electronics controls or control systems.

• Experience writing embedded firmware (C/C++) for microcontrollers or DSPs used in power converter control (e.g., TI C2000, STM32).

• Familiarity with auto-code generation from Simulink (Embedded Coder) or similar model-based design toolchains.

• Experience with real-time HIL platforms (e.g., Typhoon HIL, dSPACE, OPAL-RT).

• Knowledge of advanced modulation techniques (SVM, DPWM) and their impact on switching losses in wide-bandgap devices.

• Design-for-Reliability practices including DFMEA.

• Experience with EMI mitigation strategies at the controls and layout level.
